wild.title: Special Sauces
wild.description: * Reminder: The Savor of the Month theme for October is WATER. Details here ; Supporters can share their findings in the thread here . Check it out! Surely you’ve noticed that I have been experimenting with moving my ongoing Icebreaker series to a stand-alone post format, rather than a secondary item in the main newsletter. I’m finding this approach seems to inspire more readers to actually answer in the comments. Which is fun! I’m continuing the experiment with a new twist — or, I guess, an old one. I’ve been publishing Icebreakers for years now, and so there are many great ones that most of you have never seen. So starting today I’ll be resurfacing some old favorites in the weeks ahead. All are welcome to chime in! Noticing is about other people, too. The Icebreaker series aims to help with that. There’s a central collection spot for all the icebreakers to date, here . Today’s icebreaker, first published in 2019, comes courtesy of Friend of TAoN Erin M. Routson : If you could only use three condiments for the rest of your life, what would they be? "I love to ask people this, and then get yelled at because my definition of condiment includes guacamole," she added. And while the question may sound silly at first, it's actually a subtle test of creativity, among other things. "It's interesting to see what people think they can use across so many things, and where their preferences lie." I love it! What about you? Love to hear your answers! Leave a comment And please send your favorite icebreaker (whether you made it up or found it elsewhere) to consumed@robwalker.net . Previously: OKAY THAT’S IT! As always, I value your feedback (suggestions, critiques, positive reinforcement, constructive insults directed at me, not at anyone else , etc.), as well as your tips or stories or personal noticing rituals, things we need a word for, and of course your icebreakers : consumed@robwalker.net. Or use the comments. —> Or just click the heart symbol. That always makes my day. Share The Art of Noticing And thanks for reading … rw All this by Rob Walker (unless otherwise noted) PO Box 171, 748 Mehle St., Arabi LA 70032. To unsubscribe see the bottom of the email, or go here .
